constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("storeId", "technicianId") REFERENCES "BeautyTechnician"("storeId", id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: beauty_appointment_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status = ANY (ARRAY['RESERVED'::text, 'COMPLETED'::text, 'CANCELLED'::text, 'NO_SHOW'::text])) AND (preference = ANY (ARRAY['FEMALE'::text, 'MALE'::text, 'ANY'::text])) AND (duration > 0) AND (buffer >= 0) AND (price >= 0) AND (fee >= 0) AND ("endsAt" = ("startsAt" + ((duration)::double precision * '00:01:00'::interval))) AND ("occupiedEndsAt" = ("endsAt" + ((buffer)::double precision * '00:01:00'::interval)))))

constraints.name: beauty_customer_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist ("storeId" WITH =, "customerId" WITH =, tstzrange("startsAt", "occupiedEndsAt", '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE (((status <> 'CANCELLED'::text) AND ("customerId" IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: beauty_location_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist ("storeId" WITH =, "locationId" WITH =, tstzrange("startsAt", "occupiedEndsAt", '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((status <> 'CANCELLED'::text))

constraints.name: beauty_teacher_overlap
constraints.definition: EXCLUDE USING gist ("storeId" WITH =, "technicianId" WITH =, tstzrange("startsAt", "occupiedEndsAt", '[)'::text) WITH &&) WHERE ((status <> 'CANCELLED'::text))

constraints.name: BeautyService_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: BeautyService_storeId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("storeId") REFERENCES "Store"(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: beauty_service_trial_duration
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("trialDuration" IS NULL) OR (("trialDuration" >= 5) AND ("trialDuration" <= 720))))

constraints.name: beauty_service_values
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((duration >= 5) AND (duration <= 720)) AND ((buffer >= 0) AND (buffer <= 240)) AND (price >= 0) AND (("trialPrice" IS NULL) OR ("trialPrice" >= 0))))

constraints.name: beauty_technician_gender

constraints.name: beauty_plan_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((sessions > 0) AND (price >= 0) AND ("validDays" > 0) AND (cardinality("serviceIds") > 0)))

constraints.name: beauty_card_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((sessions > 0) AND ((remaining >= 0) AND (remaining <= sessions)) AND (paid >= 0) AND ("listPrice" >= paid) AND (cardinality("memberIds") > 0) AND ("customerId" = ANY ("memberIds")) AND ("allowShared" OR (cardinality("memberIds") = 1))))
